answer: Deadline-Bound Arrival Quotas.** Each agent identity must complete its first three outbound requests within a randomized 40–90 second window after registration, timestamped at ingress. A jetty log records arrival offsets; identities arriving too uniformly or too fast are throttled. The rule: request inter-arrival variance must exceed a per-epoch threshold, checked at the terrace gateway. Attackers running thousands of scripted identities must inject realistic jitter and stagger launches across time, cutting throughput. A wharf relay enforces the quota before routing.
